meta.homeTitle: Smart Speech Flow – Interpreting for public services
meta.description: Smart Speech Flow interprets conversations between public services and citizens in real time – in 20 languages, legally compliant and privacy-friendly. Open source.

hero.headline: Interpreting for public services
hero.subline: No conversation fails because of language anymore. Smart Speech Flow interprets in 20 languages, legally compliant and privacy-friendly.
hero.imageAlt: Consultation between a public servant and a citizen

items.title: A real interpreting dialogue, not a chatbot
items.text: Both sides speak their own language; every statement appears translated as text and audio
items.alt: Hand using a tablet with the conversation view

items.title: Runs in the browser on existing devices
items.text: No special hardware: two devices of the municipality or the visitor’s own phone
items.alt: Laptop, tablet and smartphone on a table

items.title: 20 languages
items.text: The 20 most common foreign languages in Germany are available
items.alt: Man holding up a smartphone with the language selection

items.title: Legally compliant
items.text: The only German open-source tool for legally compliant speech translation

items.title: Legally reviewed concept
items.text: Operation and conversation modes were agreed with a law firm for use in public authorities

items.title: Data protection
items.text: Open-source models run on servers in Germany

items.title: The software belongs to the municipality
items.text: Open source under the MIT licence: free to use and extend, without vendor lock-in

items.title: Pays off
items.text: From around 12 interpreter hours per month
